hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: A 3 x 3 subgrid is a valid region if the absolute difference between every pair of adjacent cells within it is <= threshold.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: For every valid 3 x 3 region, calculate its average: floor(sum / 9).

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Each cell in the output gets floor(sum of region averages covering it / number of covering regions). If no region covers a cell, keep its original value.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: 3 x 3 sliding window evaluation followed by cell-wise average reconstruction.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute force recalculation without caching covering regions takes excessive constant factor overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m * n) memory for accumulator grids.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Verify all 12 internal adjacent edges within each 3x3 block before accumulating average.
